title: Plonking Prism
statement: A palm-sized comb jelly drifts through ink-dark water, its eight rows of tiny cilia catching the faintest light and scattering it into slow, wandering rainbows. It bumps gently against a single smooth black stone, rebounds without urgency, and continues its quiet, colorless-to-colorful pulse, as though it is thinking in wavelengths it forgot to keep secret.
